description: Summarizes supplied interview notes with source-linked observations. Use when synthesizing anonymized interviews.
scope: Summarize anonymized interview notes using only supplied evidence.
steps: Group observations and cite their excerpt IDs.
checks: Every observation cites a supplied excerpt ID.
No invented participant facts or motivations.
pitfalls: Do not present an interpretation as a direct observation.

validation.case: Fictional excerpt I4: The participant prefers fewer setup screens.
validation.actual: Observation: fewer setup screens preferred [I4]. Motivation: not established.
